How does SCRIPE CRM Frontend enforce 10-Submodule Clean Architecture, Zero-Leak Persistence, and 2D Workflow Studio?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE CRM Frontend (src/modules/crm) now operates as 10 strictly decoupled Clean Architecture sub-modules (shared, workflows, settings, reports, overview, leads, opportunities, accounts, contacts, activities) backed by TanStack Query v5, Repository-to-Entity mappers, zero persist() domain stores, and automated FE-030..FE-033 + crmLocalizationAndArchGate gates.1

  1. Client-side domain workflow snapshots no longer use Zustand persist() (FE-031 = 0) and commercial package quotes are decoupled from PUT /v1/crm/settings/tenant via per-deal persistence (useOpportunityCommercialPackage).2
  2. All 4 legacy CRM entity repositories (leads, accounts, contacts, activities) and opportunities/workflows/settings normalize payloads through domain *Mapper.toEntity() contracts (FE-030 = 0, FE-010 = 0, FE-011 = 0).3
  3. All CRM ViewModels (opportunities, leads, accounts, contacts, activities, settings, reports, overview, workflows) consume TanStack Query v5 with qk.crm.* tenant-scoped keys, useSafeQueryClient, and React 19 compiler-safe primitive dependencies (FE-033 = 0).4
  4. Legacy parallel Kanban boards, redundant transition modals, dead entity tables, and the monolithic useCrmSettingsStore compatibility store have been removed in favor of unified GenericCrudView, GenericWorkflowKanban, and CrmWorkflowTransitionDialog.5

How do the 10 CRM sub-modules isolate Domain, Data, Presentation, and DI?

Diagram structure
  • @core/crud Kanban & Table core_crud
  • crm/di.ts Root Container di_root
  • crm/shared (Prefs, Lookups, PBAC) shared_mod
  • crm/workflows (Studio & Engine) workflows_mod
  • crm/settings (Tenant Governance) settings_mod
  • crm/opportunities (Deals & 360) opps_mod
  • crm/leads (Capture & Convert) leads_mod
  • crm/accounts + contacts + activities dir_mods
  • crm/overview + crm/reports exec_mods
  • core_crud → opps_mod · Unified Board & Table
  • core_crud → leads_mod · Stage Progression Grid
  • shared_mod → workflows_mod · Client Prefs & Tokens
  • di_root → opps_mod · Injects Opportunity & Workflow Repos
  • di_root → leads_mod · Injects Lead & Account Repos
  • di_root → dir_mods · Injects Account, Contact & Activity Repos
  • di_root → settings_mod · Injects Settings & Catalog Repos
  • di_root → exec_mods · Injects Overview & Reports Repos
  • workflows_mod → opps_mod · CrmWorkflowTransitionDialog
  • workflows_mod → leads_mod · Stage Evaluation & Transition Screen

Each sub-module owns isolated src/domain, src/data, src/presentation, and co-located locales/ dictionaries without cross-layer leaks. Route entrypoints under src/app/(modules)/(workspace-crm)/crm/** pair every list and 360 detail route with a dedicated loading.tsx skeleton boundary (ModulesLoadingSkeleton).5

2

How does the 2D Workflow Studio and Transition Pipeline execute safely?

Diagram structure
  • Kanban Drag or Table Action user_action
  • Pure Domain Engine (No Locales) engine_eval
  • useOpportunityCommercialPackage quote_scope
  • CrmWorkflowTransitionDialog (RHF + Zod) modal_gate
  • Repository + Mapper.toEntity() repo_sync
  • TanStack Query qk.crm.* Invalidation tq_invalidate
  • engine_eval → modal_gate · Screen Required or Exit Gates
  • engine_eval → repo_sync · Allowed Instant Move
  • modal_gate → repo_sync · Submit Validated Gate Payload
  • quote_scope → repo_sync · Isolated Per-Deal Package Sync
  • repo_sync → tq_invalidate · Refresh Deal, Lead & Pipeline Cache
  • user_action → engine_eval · Evaluate Specific-Wins Edge
  1. Pure Domain Evaluation ↗

    crmWorkflowEngine evaluates transition precedence using injected locale messages with zero locales/ imports.

  2. Unified Transition Screen ↗

    Both OpportunitiesView and LeadsView open CrmWorkflowTransitionDialog with RHF + Zod validation and custom field gates.

  3. Per-Deal Quote Isolation ↗

    Deal commercial line items persist under useOpportunityCommercialPackage scoped by opportunityId, never mutating tenant governance settings.

  4. TanStack Query v5 Refresh ↗

    Mutations invalidate qk.crm.* tenant-scoped cache keys cleanly via useSafeQueryClient.
